campaign.comparison: Six design arms plus strict novelty gate, independent fold/docking controls and retrospective affinity calibration
campaign.budget_note: Monitor billed usage before expansion; no provider hard cap promised. Design cost historical median $0.015 and P90 $0.047 per mixed-size BoltzGen job, not a quote.
gates: canonical amino acids; declared format and length
immunum numbering >=0.1 and full variable-domain coverage
canonical antibody cysteines and antibody fold diagnostics
Installed validator receipt plus additional nearest-known sequence scope check; eligibility still subject to organisers.
independent refold of plausible finalists; matched controls
campaign.stopping_rule: After 96 model-designed sequences, strict novelty rejects all16 AntiFold variants; independent docking does not support three remaining VHH poses. Stop expansion, preserve stronger Fab panel, report negative evidence transparently.
campaign.executed_expansion: 80 generated complex designs: 16 hosted BoltzGen + 64 local antibody RFD4. 16 AntiFold CDR variants. 15 canonical-Cys diagnostic variants. 20 existing Fab controls.
campaign.deviation_from_initial_scale: Do not scale unmodified hosted VHH request: all 16 lack canonical Cys, one is detected as light chain. Diagnose and compare preserved-Cys local antibody model.
campaign.final_status: Computational campaign complete. Three novelty-screened exploratory VHHs remain unsupported for binding; no prospective experimental measurements. No campaign job pending.
campaign.validator_update: Installed abguard reference index610109 was run. All3 original finalists pass installed de_novo rules. A reference-skip bug in novelty-report is bypassed via public Python API with explicit reference; team-validate and adapter agree. Installed full-sequence classification is WT-relative, not all known antibodies.

budget_final.Nebius_USD: not quoted by returned operations; participant resource

campaign.next_action: SPR + competition + direct thermal measurements, or new target-conditioned design cycle; do not submit these as validated binders

calibration.source: CA-based NAC adaptation of arXiv:2610.23136v2; region masks from immunum2.1.0
calibration.scope: Retrospective stratified 30-sequence panel, 3 Boltz2 seeds per construct, 25 quantified KD. No threshold fitting or prospective validation. Five no-reportable-KD rows excluded from continuous affinity endpoint.
